focus_areas: Verification of eyespot (ocelli) symmetry and clarity
Edge integrity between butterfly wings and grass blades
Texture consistency of body hair vs. wing scales
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the butterfly's wing edge and the background grass. AI generators often struggle with fine, irregular edges against complex textures. Also, verify if the eyespots have a natural variation or if they look like stamped duplicates.
image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on green grass blades. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is uniformly brown with distinct rows of small eyespots (ocelli) featuring white centers and black rings. The body appears slender and hairy, matching the wing coloration. The antennae are visible and appear clubbed at the ends. The background consists of out-of-focus green vegetation.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the specific species identification beyond general butterfly classification, verifying the unique ocelli pattern and wing shade.
To ensure the edges of the wings against the grass are sharp and natural, checking for any AI-generated bleeding or halo effects common in complex backgrounds.
To assess the naturalness of the texture on the wings and body, ensuring the 'hairy' texture is not smeared or artificially generated.
